27.7. Dilogarithm
(Spence's Integral for n=2)
27.7.1  f(x)=-\int_1^x \frac{\ln t}{t-1}\,dt
Series Expansion
27.7.2  f(x)=\sum_{k=1}^\infty (-1)^k \frac{(x-1)^k}{k^2} \quad (2\geq x\geq0)
Functional Relationships
27.7.3  f(x)+f(1-x)=-\ln x \ln(1-x)+\frac{\pi^2}{6} \quad (1\geq x\geq0)
27.7.4  f(1-x)+f(1+x)=\frac12f(1-x^2) \quad (1\geq x>0)
27.7.5  f(x)+f\left(\frac1x\right)=-\frac12(\ln x)^2 \quad (0\leq x\leq1)
27.7.6  f(x+1)-f(x)=-\ln x \ln(x+1)-\frac{\pi^2}{12}-\frac12f(x^2) \quad (2\geq x\geq0)
Relation to Debye Functions
27.7.7  f(e^{-t})=-f(e^t)-\frac{t^2}{2}=\int_0^t \frac{tdt}{e^t-1}
